name: dread_presence_its_second_mode_resolves_even_if_it_has_left_the_battlefield
notes: Printed: 'This creature deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.' The mode-two trigger is on the stack with the opponent's 3/3 as its target when Dread Presence is destroyed in response (step two): the ability is independent of its source (CR 113.7a), so it still resolves, the damage is dealt by Dread Presence as it last existed (2 marked on the 3/3) and seat 0 still gains 2 life (22).
